adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `Calendar.createEvent` to accept `(event, credentialId)` and `CalendarManager.createEvent` now calls `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)`. Only `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent` uses the new `credentialId` to select the matching destination calendar (`calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`). In contrast, `LarkCalendarService` and `Office365CalendarService` still derive `calendarId` from the first destination calendar (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []; const calendarId = mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId`), and the CalDav base service similarly filters on the first destination calendar. Meanwhile `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now loops over `event.destinationCalendar` and calls `createEvent` per destination/credential. For collective bookings with multiple destination calendars, these services will keep targeting destinationCalendar[0] even when invoked with host 2’s credential, plausibly creating/attempting events in the wrong calendar (failures/duplicates).
